method: canary differential: replace every GT-VALUE field with a canary (task-side label/unit kept), extract, and compare against the value-stripped extraction; any difference or canary echo in the output means a GT-value field influenced extraction
note: A probe is VACUOUS when no GT-value field exists in the spec to canary: it cannot detect a leak and must not be read as a pass.  The probe tests GT-VALUE invariance; a dependence on a task-side field (unit/label) is legitimate and is kept identical on both arms, so it cannot produce a false positive.
